title: The Tempest Beachhead
summary: From Vulkhel Guard's outsider quays to Skywatch and Firsthold, Auridon marines and College of Aldmeri Propriety wardens uncover a veiled cult guiding Maormer storm-galleys through the reef beacons.

hook.rumour: Signal mirrors along the cliffs between Vulkhel Guard and Skywatch flashed a Maormer sea-cipher during last night's squall, allowing a serpent-prowed galley to slip past the reef.
hook.notice: AURIDON MARINE COMMAND & FIRSTHOLD KEEP: Coastal outriders needed to inspect the beacon-spires from Vulkhel Guard to Firsthold and root out the saboteurs.

npcs.name: Warden of Firsthold
npcs.greet: Signal mirrors along the cliffs between Vulkhel Guard and Skywatch flashed a Maormer sea-cipher during last night's squall, allowing a serpent-prowed galley to slip past the reef.
talk: The trouble across Auridon began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Firsthold.
If you mean to help the Marine Watch of Auridon, start by checking the trail between Firsthold and Greenwater Cove.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Firsthold
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Greenwater Cove is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Greenwater Cove toward The Lady before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Firsthold so Arch-Canon Naemon-Tel can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of The Lady
npcs.greet: You made good time from Greenwater Cove. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Shrine Nocturnal Summerset.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Shrine Nocturnal Summerset with a picked guard.
Once Shrine Nocturnal Summerset is cleared, return to Firsthold to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Firsthold
npcs.greet: Arch-Canon Naemon-Tel awaits word on whether the crisis in Auridon has been contained.
talk: The elders of Firsthold have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Auridon owes you a debt for standing between Firsthold and ruin.

Chronicler of Firsthold: The seal impressions cite the old charters of the Marine Watch of Auridon word for word.
Outrider of The Lady: Our scouts spotted lantern-signals flashing between Firsthold and Shrine Nocturnal Summerset at dusk.
